payload.title: M1 Spike: publish to a Facebook Page (#1)
payload.objective: Prove with throwaway scripts in scripts/spike/ that Noon Gun can publish publicly visible text and photo posts to a Facebook Page we manage via the Graph API, and record findings in docs/platform-notes/meta.md. No application code.
successCriteria: Meta app exists with Page publishing permissions; app mode recorded
Short-lived user token exchanged for long-lived; Page token derived
debug_token output for the Page token recorded (type, scopes, expiry)
One text post and one photo post published via the Graph API
Both posts visible from a logged-out browser
Both posts deleted via the API
No token or secret committed, printed or logged
meta.md records findings and differences from the brief
